title: Balanced monthly panel by polygon unit (wide; VIIRS + MODIS metrics sensor-prefixed)

level.description: Polygon level name supplied in config (user-defined).

unit_id.description: Authoritative unit identifier. Panels must be balanced over the unit universe.

unit_name.description: Human-readable unit name from unit universe metadata (optional).

viirs_det_low.description: VIIRS: number of low-confidence detections in this unit-month. Zero when none.

viirs_det_nominal.description: VIIRS: number of nominal-confidence detections in this unit-month. Zero when none.

viirs_det_high.description: VIIRS: number of high-confidence detections in this unit-month. Zero when none.

viirs_det_nh.description: VIIRS: det_nominal + det_high. Binding contract. Must never be replaced by det_all.

viirs_frp_active_days.description: VIIRS: number of UTC days in the month with >=1 detection (post-filter, post-dedup). Zero when none.

viirs_frp_sum_daily_max_mw.description: VIIRS: sum over days of the daily maximum FRP (MW) within unit-day. Zero when none.

viirs_frp_mean_mw.description: VIIRS: frp_sum_daily_max_mw / frp_active_days. Must be null when frp_active_days=0 (NA vs 0 semantics).

modis_det_low.description: MODIS: number of low-confidence detections in this unit-month. Zero when none.

modis_det_nominal.description: MODIS: number of nominal-confidence detections in this unit-month. Zero when none.

modis_det_high.description: MODIS: number of high-confidence detections in this unit-month. Zero when none.

modis_det_nh.description: MODIS: det_nominal + det_high. Binding contract. Must never be replaced by det_all.

modis_frp_active_days.description: MODIS: number of UTC days in the month with >=1 detection (post-filter, post-dedup). Zero when none.

modis_frp_sum_daily_max_mw.description: MODIS: sum over days of the daily maximum FRP (MW) within unit-day. Zero when none.

modis_frp_mean_mw.description: MODIS: frp_sum_daily_max_mw / frp_active_days. Must be null when frp_active_days=0 (NA vs 0 semantics).
